name: marketing-agents
description: Multi-tenant marketing automation toolkit. Agents for content planning, publishing, social monitoring, market intelligence, prospecting and brand identity. Portable across clients via client-brief.json.
author: jufaldanabo

agents.name: content-publisher
agents.description: Generates and publishes daily B2B content to Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Supports approval workflow via Telegram.

agents.name: social-monitor
agents.description: Monitors comments, DMs and metrics on Instagram and Facebook. Alerts via Telegram and checks token expiry.

agents.name: market-analyst
agents.description: Monitors commodity prices and competitor activity. Generates actionable market intelligence reports.

agents.name: sales-prospector
agents.description: Searches, qualifies and reaches out to B2B leads. Manages multi-touch follow-up sequences and positive response handling.

agents.name: content-planner
agents.description: Researches trends, cultural events and competitive landscape to generate monthly content calendars for the client.

agents.name: brand-guardian
agents.description: Extracts and curates the visual and verbal brand identity from client materials (logo, website, Instagram, PDF brand manual, product photos). Produces brand-kit.json for coherent content generation.

agents.name: trend-analyst
agents.description: Detects viral content trends on YouTube and TikTok. Analyzes why videos performed well and generates actionable content ideas for the client. Weekly cadence or on-demand via /trend-ranking.

skills.name: core
skills.description: Core reusable skills: load-brief, load-brand-kit, state-store, telegram-approval, telegram-notify, preflight-check. Used by all agents.

skills.name: publishing
skills.description: B2B content generation and multi-platform publishing

skills.name: social-monitoring
skills.description: Comments, metrics, token management and Telegram alerts

skills.name: market-intel
skills.description: Commodity price tracking and competitor monitoring

skills.name: prospecting
skills.description: Lead search, qualification, outreach and follow-up sequences

skills.name: trend-analysis
skills.description: YouTube API data collection, TikTok trend discovery, viral content analysis and content idea generation
